title: 第15章 坦白从宽，抗拒从严
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: “秀兰嫂子，出啥事了？刚听见你叫唤？”是隔壁王大妈的声音，带着关切和几分好奇。李秀兰慌忙对辰楠使了个眼色，示意他别出声，自已整了整衣服去开门。“没啥事，王大妈。”李秀兰拉开一条门缝，勉强笑道，“刚看见一只大耗子窜过去，吓我一跳。”王大妈探头往屋里瞅了瞅，以她的视线角度只能瞥见了灶台上的鸡蛋：“哟，秀兰嫂子，家里买鸡蛋了？这可真是稀罕物！”李秀兰顿时紧张起来，支支吾吾不知如何作答。辰楠见状，连忙上前解围：“王阿姨，这是我昨天钓的鱼换的。”“钓的鱼？”王大妈眼睛一亮，“小楠这么能耐了？在哪儿钓的？”“什刹海，”辰楠面不改色，“昨晚睡不着，去碰碰运气，没想到真钓着几条大的。”这时，辰东南也闻声从里屋出来，听见儿子这番话，不由得皱起眉头：“你小子昨晚钓鱼去了？大晚上的多危险啊！”李秀兰赶紧把王大妈送走，关上门，长舒一口气。等门外没了声响后，二人的目光再次聚焦在辰楠身上。李秀兰揪住辰楠的耳朵：“小楠，你跟我说实话，这些东西到底哪来的？”辰楠龇牙咧嘴地求饶：“妈，轻点！真是用鱼换的！”“是我昨晚带回来的。”听完这话，辰东南二人盯着辰楠看个不停，从上到下，从下往上。“这些东西真是你带回来的？”辰东南看着厨房里的东西询问。有白糖，油盐，鸡蛋，巨型南瓜。他虽然不会做饭，但也知道这些东西需要不少钱与票。这小子没钱也没票，从哪儿搞来那么多好东西的？不会在外面做了什么犯法的事情了吧？“辰楠，你这些东西怎么来的？”李秀兰严肃地看着辰楠，“老实交代！”显然她也想到大儿子可能在外面做犯法的事情，要不然怎么可能得到那么多好东西。她们下班回家后，经常会组团一起去郊外挖野菜，可见如今的粮食有多紧缺。厨房里放着的那个巨型南瓜，黄灿灿的如此晃眼。就这体型估计得有一百来斤吧？他们一家三口吃一个月能吃完吗？“爸妈，你们想啥呢？”辰楠感受到父母那严肃的目光。他就知道，只要他拿出好东西，一定会被父母‘拷问’。这也是人之常情，做父母的都怕孩子在外面做犯法的事情。一般老妈直接喊出他全名的时候，他就知道老妈这是生气了。“东西哪来的？”辰东南也一脸严肃，“坦白从宽，抗拒从严！”“你们别这样看我啊！”辰楠欲哭无泪，他就知道会这样。把这些东西拿出来，若是没有一个好的借口。一个处理不好很有可能会引发混合双打。“你们怎么就是不信，真是我钓到鱼换来的东西。”辰楠摊开双手，表示这真是自已钓鱼换来的。辰东南将信将疑地看着辰楠。“你小子什么时候钓鱼技术这么好了？我记得上次带你去，蹲了一下午才钓上来两条小鲫鱼。”辰楠嘿嘿一笑，继续圆谎：“爸，这钓鱼讲究的不就是个运气嘛。昨晚睡不着，我就去试试，谁知道鱼群正好经过，一钓一个准。”“晚上去钓鱼？”李秀兰立刻抓住了重点，转身揪住辰楠的耳朵，“你这孩子，大晚上的多危险啊！万一掉水里怎么办？”想到前几天辰楠掉水里的事情，直至现在她都还觉得害怕。“妈，轻点轻点！“辰楠龇牙咧嘴地求饶，“我这不是好好的嘛。再说了，晚上鱼才容易上钩呢。”“我已经学会了游泳，你们就放心好了。”辰东南皱着眉头打量儿子，总觉得这孩子落水之后像是变了个人。从前看着文文弱弱的，如今却敢半夜独自去钓鱼。不过转念一想，经历生死关头，性格有所变化也是常理。“以后要钓鱼就白天去。“辰东南最终只是叹了口气，“晚上太危险，别再让我们担心了。”李秀兰松开手，仍不放心地叮嘱：“还有，这些东西...真是用鱼换的？你可千万别做什么犯法的事啊！”“这个南瓜也是换来的？这也太大了吧？”辰东南抱住南瓜抬了抬，是真的好沉重。“就是钓友没钓到鱼，跟钓友换来的。”“放心吧爸妈，犯法的事情我肯定不会做，这是正经换来的。”辰楠连连保证，顺势转移话题，“我打算过三天回乡下看看爷奶和妹妹们。“这话果然奏效。李秀兰的注意力立刻被引开，开始盘算该让辰楠带些什么回乡下。辰东南也点点头：“回去看看也好，你爷年纪大了，九个妹妹还小，家里确实需要个男劳力帮衬。”也就老家还有兄弟帮忙照看，要不然还真不敢放九个女儿在乡下给爸妈帮忙带。风波暂时平息，李秀兰开始准备早饭。虽然有了鸡蛋和白面，但她依然舍不得多用。辰楠本想提议打个鸡蛋拌面烙饼，话还没出口就被老妈瞪了回去。“这些都得省着吃。”李秀兰小心翼翼地舀了半碗玉米面，只加了小小一勺白糖，“好东西要细水长流，哪能一顿造完？”最终，早饭还是一锅玉米糊糊，只是比往常多了些许甜味。辰东南与李秀兰吃得很满足，连碗底都刮得干干净净。吃饭期间辰东南还说起自已的腿脚已经不疼了，也不知道是怎么回事。按照以往的经验，那受伤的腿脚一旦风湿痛就会持续十天左右，可这次才三两天就好了。他不知道的是，这一切都是辰楠的功劳，这些天在他吃的喝的，乃至洗脚水都是用的灵泉溪水。家里的水缸都被辰楠换上了灵泉溪水。受伤的腿脚，每天都在好转。二老只觉得最近食欲大涨，感觉喝水都是甘甜的，他们并没觉得有什么不妥，只当这是儿子没事他们心情好导致的。辰楠看着父母满足的神情，心里五味杂陈。在这个物资匮乏的年代，一点点的甜味就能让人感到幸福。“等以后天天有肉吃，妈会不会心疼得睡不着觉？”辰楠暗自好笑，却又感到一阵心酸。老妈节俭的习惯是生活所迫，要想改变，还得循序渐进。饭后，辰东南和李秀兰出门上班。辰楠站在门口，望着父母远去的背影，直到他们消失在胡同拐角，这才转身回屋，轻轻插上门闩。他意念一动，一匹浅蓝色的布料凭空出现在炕上。这是昨晚用南瓜换来的瑕疵布，虽然有些许印染不均，但质地厚实，颜色也正。一匹布三十米，九十尺。一般人想要搞到那么多布料也不太可能。辰楠拿出木尺量了量，做一套男装大概要七尺，女装的衣裳省料些，六尺足够。他比划着裁下三十尺布，小心叠好。“这些应该够给爸妈各做两身新衣裳了。”辰楠满意地点点头，将布料收回空间。剩下的布还有六十尺，他打算带回乡下给爷爷奶奶和九个妹妹做新衣。想到妹妹们穿上新衣裳的笑脸，辰楠不禁露出了笑容。这几天爸妈的关怀，让他早就融入进这个大家庭。九个妹妹，家庭成员是真多啊。还好刚才没有把布料拿出来，以老妈的性子，肯定舍不得用新布做衣裳，八成会收起来等着换粮票。还是等回乡下前再找个合适的借口拿出来。
content_en: "Sister-in-law Xiulan, what happened? I just heard you calling?" It was the voice of Aunt Wang next door, with concern and a bit of curiosity.Li Xiulan hurriedly winked at Chen Nan, telling him to be quiet, and straightened her clothes before opening the door."It's okay, Aunt Wang." Li Xiulan opened a crack in the door and said with a forced smile, "I just saw a big mouse scurrying past, which scared me." Aunt Wang looked into the room and could only catch a glimpse of the eggs on the stove: "Hey, Sister-in-law Xiulan, have you bought eggs at home? These are really rare things!" Li Xiulan suddenly became nervous and hesitated and didn't know how to answer.Seeing this, Chen Nan quickly stepped forward to help: "Aunt Wang, this is the fish I caught yesterday." "Fish?" Aunt Wang's eyes lit up, "Xiao Nan is so capable? Where did you catch it?" "Shichahai," Chen Nan said without changing her expression, "I couldn't sleep last night, so I went to try my luck.I didn't expect to catch a few big ones." At this time, Chen Dongnan came out of the back room and frowned when he heard his son's words: "Did you go fishing last night?How dangerous was it at night?" Li Xiulan quickly sent Aunt Wang away, closed the door, and breathed a sigh of relief.After there was no sound outside the door, the two of them focused their attention on Chen Nan again.Li Xiulan grabbed Chen Nan's ears: "Xiao Nan, tell me the truth, where did these things come from?" Chen Nan bared his teeth and begged for mercy: "Mom, be gentle! They were really exchanged for fish!" "I brought them back last night." After hearing this, Chen Nannan and Chen Nan kept staring at Chen Nan, from top to bottom, from bottom to top."Did you really bring these things back?" Chen Southeast asked, looking at the things in the kitchen.There is sugar, oil, salt, eggs, and giant pumpkin.Although he can't cook, he also knows that these things require a lot of money and votes.This guy has no money and no votes. Where did he get so many good things?You won't do anything illegal outside, right?"Chen Nan, how did you get these things?" Li Xiulan looked at Chen Nan seriously, "Be honest!" Obviously she also thought that her eldest son might be doing illegal things outside, otherwise how could she get so many good things.After returning home from get off work, they often form groups to dig wild vegetables in the suburbs, which shows how scarce food is today.The giant pumpkin in the kitchen is so bright and dazzling.With this body type, he probably weighs about a hundred pounds, right?Can their family of three finish it in a month?"Mom and Dad, what are you thinking about?" Chen Nan felt the serious eyes of her parents.He knew that as long as he brought out good things, he would be 'tortured' by his parents.This is also human nature. Parents are afraid that their children will do illegal things outside.Usually when his mother calls out his full name, he knows that she is angry."Where did the stuff come from?" Chen Nannan also had a serious look on his face, "If you confess, you will be lenient, but if you resist, you will be punished severely!" "Don't look at me like that!" Chen Nan was about to cry but had no tears. He knew this would happen.Take these things out if you don't have a good excuse.A mishandled move could very well lead to a mixed doubles match."Why don't you believe it? It's really something I got in exchange for catching fish." Chen Nan spread his hands, saying that this was really something he got in exchange for fishing.Chen Southeast looked at Chen Nan doubtfully."When did your kid become so good at fishing? I remember the last time I took you there, I spent an entire afternoon just catching two small crucian carp." Chen Nan chuckled and continued to lie: "Dad, fishing is all about luck. I couldn't sleep last night, so I went to try it. Who knew the fish were just right?"Go fishing at night?"Li Xiulan immediately grasped the point, turned around and grabbed Chen Nan's ear, "You kid, what if you fall into the water?"Thinking of Chen Nan's fall into the water a few days ago, she still felt scared."Mom, please be gentle!" Chen Nan bared his teeth and begged for mercy. "Isn't this a good thing? Besides, it is easier for fish to take the bait at night." "I have learned how to swim, so you can rest assured." Chen Nan frowned and looked at his son. He always felt that the child seemed to have changed after he fell into the water.Wenwen looked weak in the past, but now he dares to go fishing alone in the middle of the night.But then I thought about it, after experiencing a life and death crisis, it is normal for the personality to change."If you want to fish from now on, just go fishing during the day." Chen Southeast just sighed in the end, "It's too dangerous at night, don't let us worry anymore." Li Xiulan let go of her hand, still worried and warned: "Also, these things...were really exchanged for fish? You must not do anything illegal!" "This pumpkin was also exchanged? Isn't it too big?" Chen Southeast hugged the pumpkin and lifted it, it was really heavy."I got it from my fishing friend because he didn't catch any fish." "Don't worry, mom and dad, I will definitely not do anything illegal. This is a serious reward." Chen Nan promised again and again, changing the subject, "I plan to go back to the countryside to see my grandparents and sisters in three days." This really worked.Li Xiulan's attention was immediately diverted and she began to think about what Chen Nan should bring back to the countryside.Chen Southeast also nodded: "It's okay to go back and take a look. Your father is old and the nine sisters are still young. The family really needs a male to help." There are brothers in my hometown to help take care of them. Otherwise, I would not dare to let my nine daughters live in the countryside to help their parents.The storm subsided for the time being, and Li Xiulan began to prepare breakfast.Although she had eggs and white flour, she still couldn't bear to use more.Chen Nan wanted to suggest making pancakes mixed with eggs, but her mother glared back before she could say anything."You have to save these." Li Xiulan carefully scooped out half a bowl of cornmeal and only added a small spoonful of sugar. "Good things need to flow slowly, how can you make them in one meal?" In the end, breakfast was still a pot of cornstarch, but it was a little sweeter than usual.Chen Southeast and Li Xiulan were very satisfied with their meal, even scraping the bottom of the bowl clean.During the meal, Chen Southeast also said that his legs and feet no longer hurt, and he didn't know what was going on.According to past experience, the rheumatic pain in the injured leg and foot will last for about ten days, but this time it only took three or two days to heal.What he didn't know was that all of this was due to Chen Nan. These days, everything he ate, drank, and even used water from the Lingquan stream to wash his feet.The water tanks at home were replaced by Chen Nan with water from the Lingquan stream.The injured legs and feet are getting better every day.The two elders only felt that their appetite had increased recently, and the water they drank tasted sweet. They didn't think there was anything wrong, they just thought it was because their son was fine and they were in a good mood.Chen Nan looked at her parents' satisfied expressions and felt mixed emotions in her heart.In this age of scarcity, a little sweetness can make people feel happy."When we have meat to eat every day in the future, will Mom be so distressed that she can't sleep?" Chen Nan secretly laughed, but felt sad at the same time.Mom's frugal habit is forced by life. If you want to change it, you have to take it step by step.After dinner, Chen Southeast and Li Xiulan went out to work.Chen Nan stood at the door, watching her parents' retreating figures until they disappeared around the corner of the alley, then turned back to the house and gently bolted the door.With a thought, a piece of light blue cloth appeared out of thin air on the kang.This is the defective cloth I exchanged for a pumpkin last night. Although the printing and dyeing are slightly uneven, the texture is thick and the color is correct.A piece of cloth is thirty meters long and ninety feet long.It is impossible for ordinary people to get so much fabric.Chen Nan took out a wooden ruler and measured it. It took about seven feet to make a set of men's clothes. Women's clothes require less material, so six feet is enough.He gestured to cut out thirty feet of cloth and carefully folded it."These should be enough to make two new clothes for each of my parents." Chen Nan nodded with satisfaction and put the fabric back into the space.There were still sixty feet of cloth left, and he planned to take it back to the countryside to make new clothes for his grandparents and nine younger sisters.Thinking of the smiling faces of her sisters wearing new clothes, Chen Nan couldn't help but smile.His parents' care in the past few days has made him integrate into this big family.With nine sisters, there are so many family members.Fortunately, I didn't take out the fabric just now. With my mother's temperament, she would definitely be reluctant to use new cloth to make clothes, and she would probably put it away and wait to exchange it for food stamps.It's better to find a suitable excuse before returning to the countryside.
